metadata.name: Low Bridge
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A train heist where the train never moves; the world does. Bandits fight along the roofs of a speeding express on a trestle 40 m over a misty canyon while the bents and telegraph poles stream past. Walk through the mail car, coach, diner and caboose, or run the roofs, and drop into a gangway when the alarm sounds: a low bridge and a rock tunnel sweep the roof line. Bomb site: the strongbox in the mail car.

do.text: All aboard! Mind the low bridge and the tunnel: get off the roofs when the alarm sounds.
LOW BRIDGE! Get off the roofs!

rules.name: Low bridge: back under the canyon
